title: Open a file in TextMate and wait for it to close
summary: Use the `mate` command with the `--wait` flag to open a file in TextMate and pause the Terminal until you close the file. This is useful for scripts that need to wait for your input.

steps.explain: Run `mate` with the `--wait` flag and the file path. The Terminal will not proceed to the next command until you close the file in TextMate.

placeholders.name: FILE
placeholders.description: The path to the file you want to edit.
